backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining Nakshatra type and initializing a map with all 27 Nakshatras including their names, images, descriptions, ruling deities, symbols, and characteristics; includes blob storage mixin.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting three features related to fixing AdminPage Nakshatra display, AdminEditPage form functionality, and React Query hooks for proper backend integration.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of all frontend files describing components, pages, hooks, and utilities for the Star Fields Nakshatra application with astronomy calculations and admin functionality.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables defining OKLCH color system for light and dark themes with cosmic purple/violet aesthetic.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Star Fields application with root div and module script reference to main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component configuring TanStack Router with routes for home, Nakshatra details, and admin pages, wrapped in ThemeProvider and Toaster.
frontend/src/components/CurrentNakshatra: Banner component displaying the current Moon Nakshatra with animated moon icon and clickable link to the Nakshatra's traits page.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component with Caffeine.ai attribution link including UTM parameters and dynamic copyright year.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Application header with Star Fields branding, moon icon, and navigation links to Nakshatras and Admin sections.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Layout wrapper providing consistent header, main content area with Outlet, and footer structure for all pages.
frontend/src/components/NakshatraGrid.ts: Grid component displaying all 27 Nakshatra cards with backend images, highlighting the current Moon position, and fallback placeholders for missing images.
frontend/src/components/NakshatraImageUp: React component for uploading and validating Nakshatra images with 4:5 aspect ratio requirement, featuring preview, progress tracking, and file conversion to data URLs.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that manages the ICP actor instance based on Internet Identity authentication state, creating authenticated or anonymous actors and invalidating dependent queries on identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentNakshatra.t: React hook that returns the current Nakshatra based on real-time calculations, refreshing every 5 minutes using the nakshatraEngine utility.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React context provider and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing login state, identity persistence, and delegation validation with configurable AuthClient options.
frontend/src/hooks/useNakshatraMutations: React Query mutation hook for updating Nakshatra data via the ICP actor, with automatic query invalidation on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query hooks for fetching all Nakshatras or a single Nakshatra by name, with backend initialization and 5-minute cache stale time.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables defining a dark-themed color palette using OKLCH color space for consistent design tokens.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query client and Internet Identity provider, then renders the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/AdminEditPage.tsx: Admin page for editing individual Nakshatra details including image upload, description, deity, symbol, and characteristics with form validation and mutation handling.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin dashboard displaying all 27 Nakshatras in a grid with edit buttons, loading states, and error handling for the Nakshatra list.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Main landing page component that displays a header, description, current nakshatra banner, and a grid of all 27 nakshatras.
frontend/src/pages/NakshatraDetailPage.t: Detail page for individual nakshatras showing image, metadata, tabs for different content sections, and highlights if the moon is currently in that nakshatra. Fetches data from both local engine and backend API.
frontend/src/utils/nakshatraEngine.ts: Core utility providing nakshatra data structure, astronomical calculations for moon position using Julian Day and ecliptic longitude formulas, and functions to determine current nakshatra and lookup by slug.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom theme extensions for colors using OKLCH color space, border radius variables, animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project state tracking document indicating this is an admin dashboard fix request for displaying and editing 27 Nakshatras, with known issues around data fetching and rendering in AdminPage component.
